records.text: New signup alert -- *Pioneer Systems* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Positive, responsive admin who replied unprompted and reached first project on day 2 ([email:a1604a35], [email:4b93868e]), so engagement exists. But no invite sent, no key milestone by day 6, and tone is casual/exploratory ("still getting used to the layout"), with 8 days left and no tickets. Moderate odds unaided.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Glad to hear things are going well and that the first project is up -- getting used to the layout is normal early on. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, adding your real tasks into that project is usually the step that makes everything else click. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your setup with you and answer anything about the layout.

Best,
Chidi
